name: Cooke College Scholarship Program
amount: Up to $55,000 per year (last-dollar)
date_note: Applied through the Common App.
eligibility: High school senior graduating spring 2027; minimum 3.75 unweighted GPA; family income up to $95,000 (the page uses both 'annual gross' and 'adjusted gross' income, so verify); must submit an SAT, ACT, AP, or IB score (no minimum).
requirements: Two teacher recommendations, counselor recommendation, school report, self-reported transcript, test score(s).
essays: Not described on the how-to-apply page; check the Common App application.

name: Cooke Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship
amount: Up to $55,000 per year for 2–3 years (last-dollar)
date_note: Application listed as open on the review date.
eligibility: Top community college students with financial need who plan to transfer to a four-year college to finish a bachelor's degree. No minimum GPA is listed (recent scholars averaged a 3.94).

name: Ron Brown Scholar Program
amount: $40,000 ($10,000 a year for 4 years)
date_note: Transcripts and recommendation letters due December 15. The site lists both dates, so confirm with the program.
tags: Black / African American; Financial need; Merit-based
eligibility: Black/African American high school seniors who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents, excel academically, show leadership and community service, and demonstrate financial need.
essays: Three essays of about 500 words each. Two answer set prompts; the third is any topic (a class or college essay may be reused).

name: Dell Scholars Program
amount: $20,000 plus laptop, book credits, emergency funds, teletherapy
date_note: For the 2027 cycle the official page limits eligibility to Texas students attending Texas public universities.
eligibility: Senior graduating from a Texas high school; took part in an approved college readiness program in grades 11 and 12; plans to attend an accredited four-year public university in Texas; Pell Grant eligible; GPA of at least 2.4.
essays: Not listed on the students page; check the application.

name: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
amount: Four-year scholarship (dollar amount not stated on the 2026 flyer)
date_note: Flyer says the application opens in September 2026.
eligibility: Graduating high school seniors who are U.S. citizens with a record of academic excellence; SAT or ACT scores required.
requirements: Application, test scores, college and early career goals.

name: Burger King Scholars
date_note: Apply at burgerking.scholarsapply.org.
eligibility: High school seniors in North America, plus Burger King employees and their families. Selection weighs GPA, work experience, activities, financial need, and community service.

name: Elks Most Valuable Student Scholarship
amount: Top 20 finalists receive $30,000 (other levels: see site)
date_note: Due 11:59 p.m. Pacific. Quarter-finalists upload FAFSA Submission Summary and transcript in January.
eligibility: High school seniors who are U.S. citizens (permanent residents are not eligible). Elks membership not required. No ACT/SAT required.
essays: Additional essay at the semi-finalist stage.

name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
amount: Top award $250,000; $3.1M awarded annually
date_note: Due 8 p.m. Eastern.
eligibility: High school seniors who submit original research. See the Official Rules for full criteria.
essays: Multiple short-answer and essay responses (see application).

name: Live Your Dream Awards
amount: $1,000 – $16,000 (club, region, and international levels)
date_note: Official page lists Aug 1 – Nov 15 without a year; verify the current cycle.
tags: Women; Student parent; Adult learner; Financial need
eligibility: Women who provide the primary financial support for themselves and their dependents, show financial need, and are enrolled in or accepted to a vocational/skills program or undergraduate degree. Not for women who hold or are pursuing a graduate degree.

name: Point Foundation Flagship Scholarship
amount: Up to $15,000 per year (up to 4 years)
date_note: Closes 5 p.m. Pacific. Page lists Sept 9 – Nov 19 without a year; verify.
eligibility: Identify as LGBTQ+ or an ally; minimum 3.3 GPA; full-time at an accredited not-for-profit U.S. college (not 100% online); at least a high school senior.

name: Point Foundation Community College Scholarship
date_note: Page lists Jan 27 – Apr 8 for 2027–28 funding without a year; verify.
eligibility: Identify as LGBTQ+ or an ally; minimum 2.5 GPA; at least half-time at an accredited not-for-profit community college; no bachelor's degree.

name: Jeannette Rankin National Scholar Grant
amount: Up to $3,000 per year, renewable up to 5 years
date_note: Application and recommendation letter both due Feb 12. Notification July 31, 2027.
levels: Adult / Returning; Undergraduate; Community College; Trade / Technical
eligibility: Women 35 or older with financial need pursuing technical/vocational training, a first associate's degree, or a first bachelor's degree at an accredited nonprofit U.S. school.

name: Courage to Grow Scholarship
date_note: Deadline shown on the official page on the review date.
eligibility: High school juniors, seniors, or college students with at least a 2.5 GPA; U.S. citizens only.

name: Texas State Aid Priority Deadline (FAFSA or TASFA)
amount: State grants such as the TEXAS Grant — varies
date_note: January 15 is a priority (not hard) deadline many Texas colleges use for 2027–28 aid. Filing early improves access to limited funds.
levels: HS Senior; Undergraduate; Community College; Graduate; Adult / Returning; Trade / Technical
tags: Texas; State aid; Financial need; Low effort
eligibility: Texas residents. Students who file the FAFSA should not also file the TASFA; the TASFA is for students who do not complete the FAFSA. Check with the college to confirm the right form.

name: Terry Scholarship
amount: Full ride, last-dollar, up to 8 semesters
date_note: Deadlines are set by each of the 11 Terry-affiliated Texas public universities. Check each university's Terry page.
tags: Texas; Full ride; Financial need; Merit-based
eligibility: Texas high school seniors (no gap year) admitted to a Terry-affiliated public university; U.S. citizen or permanent resident qualifying for in-state tuition; strong academics, financial need (FAFSA), leadership; live on campus first year.
requirements: University nomination, then interview with a Terry panel.

name: Horatio Alger National Scholarship
date_note: Apply in the junior year. Application dates were not posted on the official page on the review date.
eligibility: Full-time high school juniors; adjusted gross family income of $100,000 or less; minimum 2.0 GPA; U.S. citizen; perseverance in overcoming adversity; community involvement.
requirements: Counselor certification, transcript with fall grades, income verification, support-form provider.
essays: Your Horatio Alger story plus short adversity responses.

name: HSF Scholar Program
date_note: Last cycle opened Jan 5 and closed Feb 15, 2026. Next cycle dates were not posted on the review date.
tags: Hispanic / Latino; DACA eligible; Merit-based; Financial need
eligibility: Students of Hispanic heritage; U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or DACA recipient; 3.0 GPA (high school) or 2.5 (college/grad); full-time at a four-year or graduate school; FAFSA required.

name: The Gates Scholarship
amount: Full cost of attendance not covered by other aid (last-dollar)
date_note: Closed for this cycle. Current juniors: plan to apply next summer.
tags: Pell-eligible; Full ride; Financial need; Merit-based
eligibility: Pell-eligible high school seniors; minimum 3.3 weighted GPA; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; full-time at a four-year not-for-profit college.

name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
amount: $20,000 (150 scholars)
date_note: Closed for the class of 2027. Current juniors: plan for next August.
eligibility: High school seniors with at least a 3.0 GPA; U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, refugee, asylee, Cuban-Haitian entrant, or humanitarian parolee.

name: QuestBridge National College Match
amount: Full four-year scholarship at a partner college (if matched)
date_note: Closed. Match Day is Dec 1, 2026; non-matched finalists' Regular Decision form due Dec 10. Juniors: look at QuestBridge College Prep Scholars in spring.
eligibility: High-achieving high school seniors from low-income backgrounds (see QuestBridge eligibility).

name: Patsy Takemoto Mink Education Support Award
amount: Up to $5,000 (5 awards)
date_note: 2026–27 cycle closed Aug 1, 2026. 2027–28 information expected May 2027.
levels: Adult / Returning; Undergraduate; Community College; Graduate; Trade / Technical
eligibility: Mothers 17+ with minor children; low family income (2026–27 limits: under $21,640 for 2, $27,320 for 3, $33,000 for 4); full-time; pursuing a higher level than any degree already held (vocational through doctoral).

name: NBNA Scholarship Program
amount: From $1,000
date_note: Last cycle deadline was March 15, 2026. Next cycle dates were not posted on the review date.
levels: Undergraduate; Graduate; Adult / Returning; Community College
eligibility: NBNA members (and local chapter members where one exists within 50 miles) enrolled in a nursing program from LPN/LVN through doctorate, in good standing, with at least one full year left.

name: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
date_note: Last deadline was Feb 18, 2026. Next cycle date not confirmed on the review date.
eligibility: Age 18 or younger; U.S. citizen or permanent resident living in the U.S.; significant project in STEM, humanities, or 'Outside the Box'.

name: LULAC National Scholarship Fund
date_note: Application closed on the review date; next dates not posted. You must live where a participating LULAC council operates.
levels: HS Senior; Undergraduate; Community College; Graduate; Trade / Technical
eligibility: U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or DACA recipient applying to or enrolled in college, community college, or vocational school; must live in an area with a participating LULAC council.

amount: $1 million shared by up to 100 students
date_note: Closed on the review date; next cycle not posted. Eligibility details are on a separate official page (verify).
eligibility: Verify on the official eligibility page. Selection weighs academics, community impact, personal statement, and financial need.
